kind: Read-only initial import publication review; no new behavior proof
observations: profile-registry.createProfile seeds workspace then publishes registry before returning; importProfile writes restoring journal afterward.

runtimePool.restore is invoked only after the initial synchronous journal write returns. A process-only interruption before that write does not establish a partially restored database; it may leave a published default profile without an import marker.
The initial journal write is outside the try/catch that annotates failures with profileId; an initial write error can therefore lack that recovery identity.
store.writeJson writes a temporary JSON file then renames, without fsync; power-loss durability is distinct from process interruption and has not been demonstrated.
The repaired inspector blocks corrupt existing journals. It cannot identify missing unpublished or power-loss-lost journals.
nextProof: If a separate checkpoint is opened after current CI: inject initial publication failure on disposable registry, assert selected-profile invariance and restore-call count, retain orphan/default profile evidence; distinguish process interruption from power-loss durability. Do not claim half-restored database from pre-restore ordering alone.
scope: No source edits, test reruns, real data, provider requests or acceptance changes.
